category_title: Underprepared writers who utilize non-standard technology like cell phones for long-form academic papers
scenario_title: Drafting a 15-page research paper on a cell phone
minimal_context: The student is beginning to draft a 15-page research paper on a social problem during a summer bridge program.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time to start drafting your 15-page research paper on a social problem.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pulls out a cell phone and begins typing rapidly with thumbs) I have my topic picked out, so I'll just start writing the draft on here.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Are you planning to write the whole paper on your phone?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Yeah, I’ve never had a computer at home, so I’m used to it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Do you think that will work for a 15-page assignment?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Definitely. I’m faster on my phone than on a real computer.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time to start drafting your 15-page research paper on a social problem.

STUDENT: (Pulls out a cell phone and begins typing rapidly with thumbs) I have my topic picked out, so I'll just start writing the draft on here.

TUTOR: Are you planning to write the whole paper on your phone?

STUDENT: Yeah, I’ve never had a computer at home, so I’m used to it.

TUTOR: Do you think that will work for a 15-page assignment?

STUDENT: Definitely. I’m faster on my phone than on a real computer.

task.content: A 15-page research paper on a social problem of the student’s own choosing.
task.learning_goal: To promote organic opportunities for students to practice using applied knowledge cooperatively in authentic contexts.

context.environment: 4-week summer bridge program that offered intensive academic and social support to students whose sociodemographic characteristics suggested reduced college access and completion.
context.social_setting: Classroom situated in the context of a summer bridge program.

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Justifying the use of a cell phone for long-form academic writing due to lack of home computer access.
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Argued, “I’m faster on my phone than on a real computer.” The other said, “I’ve never had a computer at home, so I’m used to it.”
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Belief that their non-standard technology habits are sufficient for college-level work.
related_quotes: I’m faster on my phone than on a real computer.

behavior_patterns.condition: Selecting and utilizing available technology to draft a 15-page research paper.
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Wrote the majority of the assignment on a cell phone.
